title: Which U.S. state will ask a court to halt further development of ChatGPT over safety concerns in September 2026?
background: ChatGPT is OpenAI’s conversational AI service. State authorities can seek court orders restricting products they allege pose risks to consumers.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official state court filings or announcements by state authorities, corroborated by reliable news reporting. 
  Qualifying Event : During September 2026, a U.S. state formally asks a court to stop OpenAI from further developing ChatGPT until safety safeguards are established. The request itself resolves the question; the court need not grant it. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The name of the U.S. state making the request.
